title: Render a markdown subset in the screen: inline code, lists, fenced code, tables

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Design, proposed 2026-10-09: a hand-rolled line-oriented parser in src/md.rs, no markdown crate. Blocks: paragraph, list (ordered or bulleted, nested by indent), fenced code with an optional language, table. Inlines: text and backticked code only. Layout is a separate pass from parse: blocks to Vec<Line> at a width, wrapping spans rather than strings, so render::wrap_at stays for the CLI. Plain text must render exactly as today; the post_box test pins that.
